command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj A64-P19-movwide.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input (268 B, LF, trailing newline). Twelve instructions: the eight new rows in lane order (`movk` lsl #0/#16/#32/#48 on x0-x3, then the same four `movn` rows on x4-x7), each with a distinct 16-bit field value, then four boundary rows (`movk x31, #0`, `movn x31, #0xffff`, `movk x8, #0xffff, lsl #48`, `movn x8, #0, lsl #48`). The first eight keep every field value distinct (Rd 0-7, imm16 0x1234/0x00ff/0xbeef/0x0001, hw 0-3); the last four pin the extremes of Rd and imm16. `llvm-readobj -r` prints an empty relocation list and the source names no symbols, so no linker is involved.
source: Arm MRS MOVK_64_movewide / MOVN_64_movewide (opc at 29+2, hw at 21+2, imm16 at 5+16, Rd at 0+5, sf = 1), measured in EXP-0028 §2-§3
